# Framework v2 — Courtside Hoops (excerpt)

The process this game runs on: phased gates, slice-by-slice builds, and a
playable harness from the first task. Task cards reference the sections below.

## Phases

Phase 0 inventories the corpus; Phases 1–4 spec and slice the work; Phase 5
builds task by task, each ending at a GATE 5 review in the harness.

## Harness

Every task must land observable in DebugBattle (F5 from the main menu). A task
with no visible result of its own is declared LOGIC-ONLY and names the task
where its effect first shows on screen. Never more than two logic-only tasks
in a row.

## Gates

A GATE 5 card carries the verify steps the human walks in the harness. The
decision is recorded and signed; three rejections block the task until it is
discussed.
